meta.title: BillSorter. Never search for invoices again.
meta.description: More invoices, more time saved. BillSorter creates order automatically. No chaos, no lost receipts.

hero.subline: More invoices, more time saved. BillSorter creates order automatically. No chaos, no lost receipts.

pain.body: More invoices means more time lost. Searching, filtering, filing. Every single month, the same drama.

solution.body: BillSorter scans daily, detects every invoice with AI, and files it in the right monthly folder. You click nothing. You search nothing. You just let go.

problem.subline: Every month, hours wasted searching, filtering and filing invoices. By the time your accountant reminds you, the receipt is already gone.
problem.pain1_body: Four hours per month. Just collecting. Time you could put into your business.
problem.pain2_body: Receipts missing, the cut-off approaches, your accountant gets impatient.
problem.pain3_body: Input tax not claimed, early-pay discounts missed, late fees collected.

features.headline: Four promises we keep.
features.f1_body: BillSorter scans daily at the time you pick. You click nothing. Invoices are just there.
features.f1_bullet2: Runs in the background, even when the app is closed
features.f1_bullet3: Catches up if your Mac/PC was asleep
features.f2_body: BillSorter tells invoices apart from newsletters, calendar pings and ads. Accurate. In any language.
features.f2_bullet2: Works in English, German, French, Italian
features.f2_bullet3: No API key required, we handle it
features.f3_body: January 2026, February 2026, automatic. Clean. Exactly how your bookkeeper wants it.
features.f3_bullet1: Sorted by mail date, not download time
features.f3_bullet2: Duplicate protection, never the same invoice twice
features.f3_bullet3: PDF, DOCX and image receipts all detected
features.f4_body: Business Outlook, personal Gmail, iCloud, IONOS. BillSorter sorts across every account.
features.f4_bullet1: Outlook 365, Gmail, GMX, Web.de, iCloud, Yahoo, IONOS, any IMAP
features.f4_bullet2: Multiple mailboxes in parallel in the same scan
features.f4_bullet3: Passwords stored encrypted in your OS keychain

how.headline: Three steps. That's it.
how.step1_body: Pick Mac or Windows. One file. Double-click. Installed.
how.step2_body: Pick a provider, paste your app password, choose a target folder. Done.
how.step3_body: BillSorter scans every day. You see what was sorted at a glance. Or never look in again.

pricing.headline: Less than a coffee-to-go.
pricing.subline: €6.99 per month. Skip your next tax panic.
pricing.feat2: AI detection, no own API key
pricing.feat4: Mac + Windows, all data stays on your machine
pricing.fineprint: 7 days free. No payment during trial. Cancel anytime.

install_mac.title: Mac install
install_mac.subtitle: One-time Gatekeeper prompt, then BillSorter runs normally.
install_mac.step1: Download the `.dmg` file and open it.
install_mac.step2: Drag BillSorter into the Applications folder.
install_mac.step3: First launch: right-click the app icon → "Open". Confirm "Open anyway". Only required once.
install_mac.step4: The setup wizard greets you. Ready in 60 seconds.
install_mac.note: We're adding the official Apple notarization in a later update. Until then, the small right-click detour.

install_win.title: Windows install
install_win.subtitle: SmartScreen warns once, then it's forgotten.
install_win.step1: Download the `.exe` file and run it.
install_win.step2: Windows SmartScreen pops up? Click "More info" → "Run anyway".
install_win.step4: Setup wizard opens automatically. Connect a mailbox, done.
